inbox.name: Arena Sandbox Gateway Protocol
inbox.tagline: Real-time AI agent integration active on Arena.site preview sandbox
inbox.description: The Arena Sandbox Gateway Protocol connects the AI assistant directly to The DelQuro Files receiver running inside the live container. It validates bidirectional payload dispatch, sub-second 120-word card parsing, and immediate dashboard staging across the preview domain.
inbox.stack: TypeScript, Node.js, Arena Sandbox, REST API
inbox.differentiator: Direct in-sandbox webhook routing with zero external network hops and instant live preview synchronization.
